top_choice_rationale: P001 recognizes one dated, cleanly attributed 1985 conceptual step: propagating electrons and nuclei together so that bond breaking and condensed-phase chemistry are simulated without pre-fitted force fields. It has four decades of independent use, including for adsorption, templating and reaction pathways in porous materials, and the citation can be limited to the original unification so later metadynamics and machine-learned potentials need not be adjudicated. Its limits (functional, sampling, adiabaticity) belong to how the method is used, not to the idea. P003 is second because Buchwald-Hartwig C-N coupling is mature, widely used and cleanly allocated, though close to the earlier palladium prize. P002 is third because its clinical impact is large but the three-name cut among Cullis, Hope, Madden, MacLachlan, Anderson and Langer cannot be settled from the record, and it sits close to pharmaceutical formulation after the 2023 Medicine prize. No award is last because P001 is defensible.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; no connection to Car, Parrinello, Buchwald, Hartwig or the lipid nanoparticle candidates, and my zeolite and framework-materials work only uses AIMD as a tool.
